noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

cloudFunc.description: The name abbreviation of this cloud resource

hasResourceArn.description: Whether this Cloud resource has resource Secondary ID

hasResourceId.description: Whether this Cloud resource has resource ID

hasResourceName.description: Whether this Cloud resource has resource name

hasResourceGroupName.description: Whether this {@link CloudResource} has resource group name

hasRole.description: Whether it is required for this {@link CloudResource} to have a {@link CloudId#role}

hasSubseq.description:
Whether it is required for this {@link CloudResource} to have a {@link CloudId#subseq}.
This could specify for each {@link CloudId#role} whether it should have a subsequence.

hasTags.description: Whether this Cloud resource has tags

identityRoleOptions.description: Whether this Cloud resource needs role field in its C3 cloud identity

nonModifiableFields.description:
A list of non modifiable fields on the resource. Must specify the full path for nested fields, separated by dot.
e.g., osProfile.computerName on AzureVirtualMachineFields type.

stripNonModifiable.description: If set, the fields set in nonModifiableFields will be removed for resource update.

hasNamespace.description: Whether this Cloud resource is associated with a namespace
